annotations.title: Plan a server and get its checkout link

description: Picks the edition, server type, plan and region for a game from what the person wants (how many players, mods or not), with the real price, and makes a checkout link on app.wilderack.com. The person opens the link, signs in or makes an account, checks everything and pays there; the server starts once it is paid. No account needed, and nothing is charged by this tool. Only games that are for sale get a link.

currency.description: usd (before tax), eur or gbp (VAT included). Default usd.

edition.description: An edition id from get_game, such as "java" or "bedrock". Default: the main edition.

game.description: A game name or id, such as "minecraft", "terraria" or "factorio".

modded.description: True for mods or plugins, which need more memory. For Minecraft Java mods (not plugins), also set serverType: fabric, neoforge or forge.

modpack.description: A Modrinth modpack id or slug, for games that take modpacks.

name.description: The server's name, if the person said one.

period.description: month, quarter (every 3 months, 10% less on plans that sleep), year (15% less on plans that sleep) or pass3d (a 3-day pass that never renews). Default month.

plan.description: A plan id to use as is, such as ram-6g, instead of the suggested one.

players.description: How many people play at once, at most.

region.description: A region id from list_regions. Leave out to let the person pick at checkout.

serverType.description: A server type id from get_game, such as paper, fabric or forge. Default: the one Wilderack suggests.
